implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.read_text_file in file_handler.py implements reading with multiple encodings and error handling.
parse_arguments function in main.py uses argparse to collect file path and options.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic words, sentences/phrases, and optional substrings
implemented_requirements.evidence: palindrome_detector.py only contains a placeholder class definition with "class PalindromeDetector: ..." and no implementation of an analyze method.
ReportGenerator.generate_report in report_generator.py contains only a skeleton that appends a few header lines and ellipsis placeholders.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Write report to optional output file
implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.write_text_file in file_handler.py writes a string to a file, and main.py calls it when --output is supplied.

critical_issues: palindrome_detector.py lacks any functional code; no analyze method or palindrome detection logic is present.
report_generator.py does not construct a complete report; it contains ellipsis placeholders and never accesses the detection results meaningfully.
Running main.py will raise AttributeError or ImportError because the expected methods/classes are missing.
No unit tests or example usage demonstrating actual palindrome detection are provided.
judge.summary: The submitted code provides utilities for file I/O and command‑line parsing, but the core functionality—detecting palindromes and producing a full report—is missing. Consequently, the program cannot fulfill the benchmark requirement and is unlikely to run successfully.
